tasks.title: T17-US-001: Interactive map geometry drawing tool
tasks.description:
As a contributor, I want to draw regions, trade routes, and migration paths directly on the map so I can author geographic data without editing TSV by hand.

Acceptance criteria (all must be met before marking complete):
- Add a click-to-draw component (a draw library such as leaflet-draw/terra-draw, or a custom handler) for polygons and lines on the main map
- Drawn geometries persist as GeoJSON via a new POST endpoint and land in the appropriate lexicons/*.tsv (or the contribution queue) with provenance source='user-drawn'
- Support editing/deleting a drawn shape before submit; associate it with an entity + time range
- vitest tests cover geometry serialization and the persistence endpoint; `npm run check` passes
